description: Built November 1973; delivered 18 January 1974; registered 30 January 1974 as CCCP-87367 to the Urals Civil Aviation Directorate at Chelyabinsk-Balandino; to the Uzbek Civil Aviation Directorate 7 July 1987; to Uzbekistan Airways 1993 as UK-87367; ran off the runway at Urgench 9 April 2003 and was struck off before 2007; erected on a children's playground in Karshi still in Uzbekistan Airways colours and used as a children's cinema; year_built from the registry's stated build month
